subject: reasoning
question: Kasish starts from Point A and drives 10 km towards south. She then takes a left turn, drives 6 km, turns left and drives 11 km. She then takes a left turn and drives 7 km. She takes a final left turn, drives 1 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should she drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Kasish starts from Point A and drives 10 km towards south.

She then takes a left turn, drives 6 km, turns left and drives 11 km.

She then takes a left turn and drives 7 km.

She takes a final left turn, drives 1 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/036cbf51927654fb8d4d12e05e6bc6a089debf65d75ba4555b88d728d6097447.png] 

So, She should drive **1 km to east** in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
